comparison.objective: Seat a platform on matching cone, groove, and flat kinematic datums; candidate extracts a connector contact.
comparison.physical_skill: PR tests bimanual platform alignment, level lowering, and simultaneous three-point seating. Candidate tests recessed tool insertion, two-tang force control, and opposite-side wire pull.
comparison.success_condition: PR requires three datum contacts within clearance and pose tolerances, release, and 1 s stability. Candidate requires selective terminal exit, retained neighbors, intact housing/crimp/tool, and 3 s stability.
comparison.reason: Precision seating on kinematic datums is not the same tested ability as selective latch-mediated extraction.
